name: strat-scanner
description: Local-only long-bias Strat (Rob Smith) stock scanner

scripts.themes:sync: node scripts/setup.mjs && cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m strat.themes sync
scripts.themes:check: node scripts/setup.mjs && cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m strat.themes check
scripts.test: node scripts/setup.mjs && cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && cd ../web && npm test
